meta.name: build
meta.description: Build feature/page/integration end-to-end with GO/NO-GO gate. For components use `/component`, hooks `/hook`. Triggers "build a feature/page", "implement feature", "add feature", "build integration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 端到端交付功能、页面或集成的完整开发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在门控检查下快速完成功能开发
copy.tagline_en: Deliver features, pages, or integrations end-to-end with GO/NO-GO gates
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly develop a feature or page with quality gates

howto.what: Claude 会分三个阶段构建功能：先研究需求和技术栈（含 GO/NO-GO 门控），然后制定实施计划，最后编写代码并输出总结。
howto.when: 当你说出“build a feature/page”、“implement feature”等类似话语时触发。

say.text: 帮我构建一个用户登录页面。
say.note: Claude 会先检测技术栈再实施。

say.text: 实现一个数据导出功能。
say.note: Claude 会研究现有代码并生成计划。

howto.what_en: Claude will build a feature/page/integration in three phases: research (with GO/NO-GO gate), plan, and implement. It detects the tech stack, fetches docs, and outputs a summary.
howto.when_en: When you say "build a feature/page", "implement feature", or similar phrases.

say_en.text: Build a user login page for me.
say_en.note: Claude will detect the stack first.
